blocks.title: Scalars
blocks.text: Scalars woh physical quantities hain jo sirf miqdar (magnitude, size ya amount) se bayan hoti hain, simt ka koi zikr nahi. Yun scalars be-simt hain aur ek adad aur us ke unit se poori tarah bayan ho jati hain.

blocks.caption: Scalars ki misalein
rows: kisi cheez mein madde ki miqdar
simt se qata nazar kisi cheez ke tay kiye raste ki kul lambai
woh raftar jis se koi cheez faasla tay karti hai
kisi madde ke zarraat ki ausat kinetic energy ka paimana

blocks.prompt: Safar ke baad car ka odometer 50 km zyada dikhata hai aur speedometer zyada tar raste 40 km h^-1 dikhata raha. Yahan kaun si miqdarein scalar hain, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Dono: odometer tay kiya faasla deta hai, raste ki kul lambai jis ki koi simt nahi, aur speedometer speed deta hai, faasla tay karne ki raftar. Koi bhi nahi batata ke car kis taraf gayi, is liye dono scalar hain.

items: Scalar: sirf miqdar, unit ke saath ek adad; mass, distance, speed, time, energy, temperature.
